videos.title: Dingiri Dingalae | SASO |  Alvin Arumugam | Arr. Augustine Paul | The Chennai Chorale | Madras Music
videos.description:
Experience a grand orchestral rendition of the beloved tune, "Dingiri Dingalae," performed by the South Asian Symphony Orchestra (SASO) in collaboration with The Chennai Chorale.

​Recorded live at the Asian College of Journalism (ACJ) in Chennai, India, this performance showcases a magnificent fusion of a full-fledged symphony orchestra - featuring powerful brass, delicate woodwinds, soaring strings, and rhythmic percussion - alongside a vibrant SATB choir.

​This unique arrangement by the renowned Augustine Paul brings a sophisticated, symphonic depth to the traditional melody, led by the baton of conductor Alvin Arumugam.

​[Credits]

​Ensemble: South Asian Symphony Orchestra (SASO)
​Choir: The Chennai Chorale
​Conductor: Alvin Arumugam
​Arranger: Augustine Paul
​Venue: Asian College of Journalism, Chennai

About Music Madras:

Welcome to Music Madras.

Music Madras exists to preserve, document and celebrate Western Classical Music in Chennai-and eventually across India.

Through professional concert recordings, educational content and a growing digital archive, we are creating a living archive of performances, musicians, choirs, orchestras, churches and musical heritage.

We believe every performance leaves behind an acoustic amber-a fleeting moment of music that deserves to be preserved, studied and shared with future generations.

Whether you're a performer, student, educator or music lover, we invite you to join us on this journey.

videos.title: Dancing into the Promise|John Carter | Mary Kay Beall| BHC Choir| MCC | Jacob George |12 Dec 2025
videos.description:
Dancing Into the Promise! is a joyful Advent choral anthem by John Carter, with text by Mary Kay Beall.

Inspired by the Advent imagery of coming together in anticipation of Christ's birth, the piece has a lively, celebratory character and was written for three-part mixed choir. It is suitable for Advent services and Christmas concerts. 

This performance features the BHC Choir, conducted by Jacob George, and is presented as part of Music Madras' growing archive of Christian, choral and sacred music.

🎼 Work: Dancing Into the Promise!
🎼 Composer: John Carter
🎼 Text: Mary Kay Beall
🎼 Choir: BHC Choir
🎼 Conductor: Jacob George
🎼 Venue/Church: Bishop Heber Chapel

Captured by Music Madras -  preserving and sharing Chennai's rich musical heritage through its people, music and stories.
